Hello, my friend! I am Ananse. Today we are learning before and after.
Here are the numbers, one to ten, standing in a row.
The number before five is the one on the left. It is four.
The number after five is the one on the right. It is six.
Before is the left. After is the right. Always.
Now let us stand on eight.
Before eight is seven. After eight is nine.
Now let us stand on one, at the very front.
After one is two. But what comes before one?
Nothing! One is first. On this line, nothing comes before one.
Oh! A number has run away. Which one is missing?
Look at the gap. Six is before it. Eight is after it.
It is seven! Here comes seven back.
Here we go again. Which number is missing now?
Two is before it. Four is after it. It is three!
Well done, my friend! Now it is your turn.
Play Number Train. Drag the missing number into the empty carriage.
